rows.text:
- Independent review by migration_plan_review using the shared Codex identity: submitted target revision 579 and candidate source revision 578. Accept this planning revision; no remaining high-level blocker found.
- The active sequence has no intermediate human gate: a starting checkpoint and three coherent commit checkpoints follow independent agent checks, preserving unrelated edits and recording exact per-repository revisions/evidence.
- Compiler rejection cases, dependency checks, existing model derivation and before-replacement runtime/data rehearsal remain mandatory. Node editor/data-model inspection explicitly covers entity components, values, component types, properties and actual declared data types.
- Only final human inspection remains, after verified commits. This review approves the plan only; no implementation, code, tests, data migration or human outcome has been approved or performed here.
